title: Excellent Private Tour with the Perfect Pace
text: We really enjoyed our private Alcázar tour! Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and spoke clear, easy to understand English. He arrived on time at our designated meeting location and kept the tour moving at just the right pace for us; efficient without feeling rushed with plenty of time to appreciate the sights. Overall, a great experience that we would highly recommend!
author: Eric_B

title: This was an excellent...
text: This was an excellent tour. Farran was an exceptional guide! He provided a lot of Spanish history in addition to information on the palace. (I wish I could have him for every tour🙂) The palace has some uneven floors so it’s probably not a good place for those with serious mobility issues.
author: Melissa_S

title: Real Alcazar Tour
text: Great guy, great tour. Just the right level of detail. Really interesting and I think we would not have got anywhere near as much out of visiting Real Alcazar without the information and explanations on the tour.

title: Perfect from start to finish!
text:
It was as a very smooth experience from booking, contact from the local manager, through to our knowledgeable guide. 

We choose a ‘small party’ tour which was ideal for us! The guide gave us headphones so we could always hear what he was saying even if he was a few paces ahead of us.

title: Very happy with the service from start to finish!
text:
Booking was simple and good communication with the Area Manager about the meeting point, timings and name of the guide! 

We went to Real Alcázar in Seville in a small
Party of 10. We had individual headsets so we could hear the guide at all times, even if he was a pace or two ahead of us! (I had my own headphones with a jack connection so used my them but the ones he provided  seemed to be comfortable one, over the ear, headphones) 

Our guide was Andres. He was knowledgeable and had so much information about Seville and its relevance in world history.

title: You can’t beat Andres!
text: Andres, our tour guide, was interesting, organized, knowledgeable and super-personable. I can’t imagine a better tour guide for Sevilla!!! Because of his expertise we enjoyed a focused and engaging tour of the amazing Alhambra. Gracias, Andres!
author: JaniceFloyd_D

title: An Alcazar Must!
text: Well worth getting a guide to see the Alcazar.  Highly recommend doing a small group tour. Rosa was very informative and lots of fun.
author: David_N

title: A must in Seville
text: The private tour of the Alcazar is an incredible experience, a step back in time. Our guide, Lola, was so informative, relating history, stories and anecdotes. It was a highlight of our time in Seville.
